headline: National Police Chief Urges Integrity During 81st Brimob Anniversary
metaDescription: National Police Chief Jenderal Suyudi emphasized the importance of ethics, integrity, and public trust during the 81st anniversary of the Brimob Corps.
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief Jenderal Suyudi highlighted the need for personnel to maintain professional ethics and integrity.
The Chief cautioned against prioritizing artificial image building and advised personnel to focus on earning public trust.
Official events included health support visits for recovering personnel and guidance on avoiding prohibited activities like gambling.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian National Police celebrated the 81st anniversary of the Mobile Brigade Corps (Brimob). During the commemoration, National Police Chief Jenderal Suyudi issued several directives to personnel, focusing on moral conduct, solid internal integrity, and service to the public. He emphasized that legal enforcement efforts are ineffective without strong ethical standards. The Chief specifically warned personnel against involvement in illicit activities, including drug use and online gambling. Furthermore, he noted that the police force should focus on genuine service rather than utilizing paid surveys to improve public image. As part of the anniversary events, leadership from the Polda Metro Jaya also conducted visits to personnel currently undergoing medical treatment to provide morale and institutional support. The Chief reflected on the history of the organization, referencing past challenges regarding compensation and resource management.
whyItIsViral: The event is being tracked by three independent news outlets with a moderate pace of coverage across national media platforms.
